title: A Goblin Shark Fires Its Jaws Out of Its Face at 3 m/s

scenes.text: A goblin shark can shoot its jaws out of its own face.
Scientists filmed it with a high-speed camera. The lower jaw lunges forward at over three meters per second.
In about a tenth of a second, the jaws leap out nearly ten percent of the shark's body length.
That's up to nine times farther than the jaws of other sharks.
Researchers describe it as a slingshot mechanism.
So yes, a goblin shark fires its own face.
